Recorded claim:
`moz-message-bar type="warning"` supports heading/message, actions, optional dismissal and links, defaults to `role="alert"`, and its CSS supports wrapping/shrinking in narrow containers. `MozElements.NotificationBox` is for managed stacks of independent notices and is more infrastructure than one selected-address-book warning needs. [Task 1]
